items: The initial merge-diff contradiction was resolved by the revised brief. Metadata uses explicit parent-to-commit diff-tree arguments; the independent validation disables rename detection to match that command.
Copied shared dependencies and extracted the unchanged CSV writer to preserve imports without modifying the previous experiment.
Both prior release matrices were renamed byte-for-byte to prev-prefixed names before writing commit matrices.
LLM compilation and initial runs retain the prior file-worker parallelism inside isolated commit workers; exact failure reruns retain the same runner and status rule.

Coverage uses the existing Python java_options hook, so no runner CLI or method timeout change was necessary. Execution filenames include CUT and technique to avoid collisions between identical generated test class names.

Coverage totals sum class-level counters including inner/anonymous classes, as specified. The previous experiment used source-file counters and broader execution; both factors can produce coverage differences.

Matplotlib was absent from the reused image. It and its dependencies were installed through the build service into the ignored tools/python directory; plotting runs with those packages in the network-disabled run service. Package versions are recorded in plot-packages.json.

The baseline build was copied, with copy duration recorded and its original build log retained. Setup/initial inspection time was not separately measured; build, execution, analysis and continuation durations are recorded independently.
Corrected a syntax error in an ad hoc final-checkpoint preview command before it produced output; no experiment measurements were rerun or altered.
